role: paired development ablation of the two frozen V4 reserve components
registration_context: complete V3 and V4 outcomes known; inventory-only and power-only outcomes unobserved

conditions.name: inventory_reserve_only
conditions.power: retain V3 received-future headroom and joint nomination bound; no recent-peak power bound

conditions.name: power_reserve_only
conditions.target: retain V3 profile fraction times unit capacity
conditions.power: retain V4 observed opposite-unit peak bound, received-future headroom and joint nomination bound

unchanged_contract: same 64 library profiles plus three reference constants, same original April/July/October 2024 samples and all 73 complete windows per sample; original asset, stocks, efficiency, lead, signal calibration, receipt visibility, failure event, 95% criterion and cost accounting
execution: run the two conditions serially from local caches; reuse saved V3 and V4 comparisons without rerunning either
analysis: report each condition's seasonal and common feasible library sets
pair identical profile-window outcomes against V3 and V4, retaining gains and losses
report first inventory and shared-power failure causes, including the fixed 50% reference
do not rank incomplete methods by conditional completed-window costs
decision: if neither component passes the unchanged all-season development gate, keep this 90-minute reserve family on HOLD; if a component passes, assess its control and source-data protocol before any source comparison
limitations: post-V4 development ablation, not independent confirmation; overlapping windows and exogenous historical BOAs retain their original interpretation
